_comment: Per-repo base branch + local-CI command profiles for /ship-dag's engine-invocation path (SKILL.md step 4). emit-config.mjs turns the profile for each ready-wave repo into the config's repos: map (baseBranch + postSessionCheck). Keys are owner/repo. baseBranch defaults to main when a repo is absent here; commands default to none (the wave lands with no post-session check — emit-config warns). Keep commands aligned with each repo's own CI (its CLAUDE.md / workflow); they run through a shell from the worktree root, so a `cd <subdir> && …` prefix and shell constructs are fine. Set baseBranch explicitly for a repo whose default branch is not main (e.g. an iOS repo on master).
